categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu HHCK Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor packaging materials, specifically epoxy molding compounds (EMC) and electronic adhesives. These products serve semiconductor packaging and board-level assembly applications, covering both traditional and advanced packaging technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced formulation and production process technologies for epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives. It employs automated and intelligent manufacturing lines, including granular powder production equipment for advanced packaging like FOWLP/FOPLP. The R&D emphasizes low-stress, high-reliability, warpage control, high thermal conductivity, and high-voltage resistance technologies tailored for various packaging formats.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor packaging companies such as JCET, TFME, Huatian Technology, Galaxy Microsystems, Yangjie Technology, and Fuman Microelectronics. The end markets served are semiconductor chip packaging, automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and emerging fields like AI, 5G, and IoT, with a focus on both domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone. It plans to extend production and sales bases to South Korea and Malaysia through acquisitions, aiming to become a world-class semiconductor packaging materials enterprise.
categories.supply_chain_position: HHCK operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, producing critical packaging materials such as epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives used by downstream semiconductor packaging and testing companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in advanced packaging materials aligned with evolving semiconductor packaging technologies, including QFN, BGA, SiP, WLP, and FOWLP/FOPLP. It emphasizes innovation in low-stress, high thermal conductivity, high reliability, and automotive-grade materials. Strategic initiatives include automation and digitalization of production, talent retention via stock incentives, and expanding R&D capabilities to accelerate product development and industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor packaging materials, including epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives, to semiconductor packaging companies. The company operates a direct sales model supplemented by trade customers, with revenues recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HHCK competes with major foreign suppliers dominating the high-end semiconductor packaging materials market. It holds a leading position domestically in epoxy molding compounds and is recognized as a key domestic player advancing localization and substitution of imported materials. The company is expanding its footprint in advanced packaging materials to challenge foreign incumbents and increase market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 331.6 million, a 17.23% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 40.06 million, up 26.63%. Total assets reached RMB 1.4 billion, growing 13.99% from the prior year. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by industry recovery and increased capacity utilization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HHCK emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering traditional and advanced semiconductor packaging materials with strong customization capabilities. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced formulation technologies, automated intelligent manufacturing, rapid customer response, and a robust R&D team led by industry experts. The company positions itself as a domestic leader enabling semiconductor material localization and high-performance packaging solutions.
